criteria.name: Technical Competency
criteria.description: Assess the candidate's technical knowledge, problem-solving ability, and hands-on experience with relevant technologies.

criteria.name: Communication Skills
criteria.description: Evaluate how clearly the candidate articulates their thoughts, explains technical concepts, and responds to questions.

criteria.name: Problem-Solving Approach
criteria.description: Assess the candidate's analytical thinking, creativity in solving problems, and systematic approach to challenges.

criteria.name: Cultural Fit
criteria.description: Determine alignment with company values, team dynamics, and work style preferences.

criteria.name: Motivation and Interest
criteria.description: Gauge the candidate's genuine interest in the role, company, and long-term career goals.
